August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 129)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 25 across American network, Betty Garde starring as NYPD Policewoman Mary Sullivan on Police Woman for Arrid, George V. Denny Jr. moderating a heated debate on post-armistice Korea on America's Town Meeting of the Air, two classic late-night Jean Shepherd monologues live on WOR (avoiding 'The Real World' in 1965 and Shea Stadium bedsheet banners in 1972), Kate Smith welcoming Woody Herman's Thundering Herd for Jell-O, and Carleton Young as The Count of Monte Cristo foiling Venetian assassins (1944–1972):
